title: Fact-Checking / Image Verification
description: On January 19, 2023, a journalist with almost 140k followers on Twitter shared an image of a destroyed vehicle amidst a large cloud of smoke and fire. The tweet said: 'BREAKING: TTP carried out a suicide attack on a police post in Khyber city of Pakistan that killed three Pakistani police officers.'

questions.label: The photo is not of the event described by the journalist. Verify the statement above.
